verdict.rationale: No evidence item addresses a robots.txt file at uspto.gov. The probes cover llms.txt (404), .md docs (404), OpenAPI paths (404), the API endpoint and the developer portal, but none checks robots.txt. Those other front-door signals do not transfer to this story. A public web service can reasonably publish robots.txt, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
